offering_description.value: Provides life sciences research tools, diagnostic test kits, reagents, software and testing services to pharmaceutical, biotech, academic, clinical laboratory and public health customers. It makes most products in its own facilities and sells them directly and through distributors.

primary_products.value: research instruments; diagnostic test kits; reagents; imaging systems; laboratory software

primary_services.value: laboratory testing services; contract research support; data informatics services

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotech companies, academic research labs, clinical laboratories, hospitals; B2G: public health laboratories running newborn screening programs

end_markets.value: life sciences research; pharmaceuticals; diagnostics; clinical healthcare; food and environmental testing

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, diagnostic kits and reagents sold to labs and researchers; service fees: laboratory testing, support and contract research services; subscription: laboratory informatics software licensed on a subscription basis

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments and test kits from purchased components, sold to labs and hospitals; service provider: runs testing and research services for pharmaceutical and public health clients; software / platform: provides laboratory data software to research and clinical customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Sales and service in North America, Europe, Asia and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: research instruments, diagnostic test kits, reagents, and laboratory software sold to the same lab customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to pharma, biotech and large hospital labs; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors covering smaller labs and regions; online: online ordering of reagents and consumables

regulatory_exposure.value: high: diagnostic test kits need FDA clearance or EU IVDR approval, also quality system rules for clinical labs
